text:
maria: Quick question — deploying the payment subchart ends up creating a ServiceAccount in the umbrella release namespace, but the IRSA annotation we set via values keeps disappearing after helm upgrade. Anyone seen a subchart SA overwrite annotations?
kevin: :eyes: can you paste the values you passed for the subchart?
maria: sure — we set this in values.yaml for the umbrella chart:
```
payment:
  serviceAccount:
    create: true
    name: payment-sa
    annotations:
      eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/payment-role
```
maria: after helm deploy the SA exists but the `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` annotation is gone. kube shows no annotation on the SA resource.
jonathan: likely a name collision: if another chart/resource manages the same SA name, Helm (or k8s) can replace the resource and not include your annotations. Does any parent chart or other subchart also create `payment-sa`?
kevin: also check if the subchart template explicitly sets `metadata.annotations` or if Helm is doing a replace with empty annotations. If you set `name: payment-sa` in multiple places, the later apply wins.
maria: umbrella chart doesn't create it, but CI sometimes installs the subchart separately for integration tests — could be the separate install that has `create: true` but no annotations.
jonathan: common fixes: (1) create the SA only in umbrella (set subchart `serviceAccount.create: false`) and manage annotations centrally, or (2) make the SA name unique per release so other installs don't collide, e.g. `{{ include "fullname" . }}-payment`.
kevin: if you can't edit the subchart easily, you can use Helm's `lookup` to conditionally create the SA in the umbrella templates so you don't stomp others. Example snippet:
```
{{- $existing := lookup "v1" "ServiceAccount" .Release.Namespace "payment-sa" }}
{{- if not $existing }}
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: payment-sa
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: {{ .Values.payment.serviceAccount.annotations.eks\.amazonaws\.com/role-arn | quote }}
{{- end }}
```
kevin: FWIW if two different helm releases own the same SA name, `helm uninstall` of one can remove it and strip annotations — avoid cross-release resource ownership.
maria: editing the upstream subchart requires a PR which will take a while. Any Terraform/CI quick fixes?
jonathan: you can run a small post-deploy `kubectl annotate serviceaccount payment-sa -n $NS eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/payment-role --overwrite` in CI as a stopgap. Not ideal but pragmatic.
ci-bot: Note from CI: added optional `post_deploy_patch` job that runs when `helm.values.override.post_patch = true` — can apply SA annotation in the same pipeline.
kevin: also ensure `automountServiceAccountToken` isn't being set to `false` anywhere — IRSA needs token projection on the SA (or projected SA token feature).
maria: good call, I'll verify `spec.automountServiceAccountToken` after patch.
maria: ok i'll add the CI patch for now and open a PR to change the umbrella values to `payment.serviceAccount.create: true` there and set `create: false` in subchart via values, so we own the SA once. thanks all :thumbsup:
